card.name: Words just before oncology brand names
card.fires_on: Linking words such as of, with, after, including, or receiving, and the middle of a brand name like IMBRUVICA, right before a cancer drug brand name (IMBRUVICA, VENCLEXTA, GAZYVA, TREANDA). Seen in leukemia and lymphoma labels.

modes.label: Linking word before brand
modes.description: A small word like of, with, or including that directly precedes a cancer drug brand name.

modes.label: Inside brand name
modes.description: Partway through the brand name IMBRUVICA, when the rest of the name is about to follow.
